name: Lemmysuchus
sum: Machimosaurid thalattosuchian from the Middle Jurassic (Callovian) of England and France, with blunt, rounded teeth.
holotype: NHMUK PV R 3168, a partial skeleton from the Oxford Clay of Cambridgeshire.
material: Described as 'Steneosaurus' obtusidens by Andrews in 1909, with a short rostrum, blunt teeth and armour with elongate pits.
biology: The article consulted gives no further information on its biology.
author: Johnson et al. 2018

images.caption: Fossil specimen
